fallback.initBody: We could not finish setting up the app. This is usually temporary. Try again, or restart the app.
fallback.errorBody: We hit an unexpected error. You can try again, restart the app, or send us feedback so we can fix it.
fallback.storageBody: The data on this phone can't be read. Reset it to keep using Expenzo. Anything you synced comes back after you sign in.
fallback.resetConfirm: This deletes the transactions, budgets and categories saved on this phone. Synced data comes back after you sign in. Changes that weren't synced are lost.

smsGate.title: SMS access required
smsGate.body: Expenzo needs access to your SMS to automatically track expenses from your bank and payment apps. Your messages never leave your device.
smsGate.deniedBody: SMS permission is permanently denied. Enable it in app settings to use the smart scanner.
